steps.message:
Hi! 👋 Welcome to support.

Please select an option:
1️⃣ Order Issue
2️⃣ Product Inquiry
3️⃣ Speak to Agent

Reply with 1, 2, or 3.
We are sorry about the issue! Please share your order ID and we will look into it right away.
Sure! Tell us which product you are interested in and we will share all the details.
Connecting you to a live agent. Please hold on — someone will be with you shortly.

🕐 Our Business Hours:

Mon–Fri: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Saturday: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Sunday: Closed

For urgent queries, reply "urgent" and we will get back to you ASAP.
Noted! We have flagged this as urgent. Our team will reach out within 30 minutes. Thank you for your patience!

We value your feedback! 🎯

How would you rate your experience?
⭐ 1 — Poor
⭐ 2 — Fair
⭐ 3 — Good
⭐ 4 — Great
⭐ 5 — Excellent

Reply with a number 1–5.
We are sorry to hear that! 😔 We want to make it right. Please share what went wrong so we can improve.
Thank you for your feedback! 😊 We are always working to get better. Let us know how we can improve further.
Wow, thank you for the 5-star rating! 🌟 We are thrilled you had a great experience. Share us with your friends! 🎉

📦 Track Your Order

Please share your Order ID so we can check the status for you.

Thank you! Let me look up your order. 🔍
One moment please...

✅ Your order is currently being processed.
📅 Expected delivery: 3–5 business days.

Need more help? Reply "help" to speak to support.
